summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) entry in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry and Control.title(). rich/console.py adds set_window_title(), which returns True when a control is written and False otherwise. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_console.py (set_window_title, skips on legacy Windows), test_control.py (Control.title segment), test_windows_renderer.py (set_title called once). Not verified: tests, mypy, and Black were not run per instructions.
